copy.tagline: 为应用添加用户认证与组织管理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中快速集成用户注册、登录和组织管理功能
copy.tagline_en: Add user authentication and organization management to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly integrate user sign-up, login, and organization management into your app

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你集成 Clerk 身份认证：设置 ClerkProvider 和中间件保护路由，使用预置的登录/注册组件，通过钩子获取用户状态，并在服务端验证身份和组织权限。
howto.when: 当你需要为应用添加用户登录、注册、权限管理或多租户组织功能时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Clerk 设置登录页面和路由保护。
添加一个只有管理员能访问的仪表盘页面。
配置 webhook 同步用户数据到数据库。
say.note: Claude 会生成 verifyWebhook 处理函数。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps integrate Clerk authentication: set up ClerkProvider and middleware for route protection, use pre-built sign-in/sign-up components, access user state via hooks, and verify identity and organization permissions on the server side.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to add user login, registration, permission management, or multi-tenant organization features to an application.

say_en.text: Set up a sign-in page and route protection with Clerk.
say_en.note: Claude generates ClerkProvider and middleware code.

say_en.text: Add a dashboard page accessible only to admins.
say_en.note: Claude uses auth.protect() with role check.

say_en.text: Configure a webhook to sync user data to the database.
